article.title: Fee for registration of documents.
article.content: There shall be paid to the Registrar for registering any document required by the provisions of this Chapter to be registered by him, such fee, as may be prescribed.
article.html:
385Fee for registration of documents.

Section 385 · Chapter XXII · page 224 of the Act

There shall be paid to the Registrar for registering any document required by the provisions of this Chapter to be registered by him, such fee, as may be prescribed.
